name: Cut-Paper Stage
description: The subject rests exactly where four sharply-angled sheets of matte colored paper converge into a graphic-design-built stage, each plane a hard-edged saturated hue with crisp shadows and zero blending between them. Lit with a flat poster-style key so every shadow reads as a clean graphic shape, not a photographic gradient.
lighting: Flat poster key, hard graphic shadows
subject: product
prompt: resting exactly where four sharply-angled matte cut-paper planes — cobalt blue, cherry red, golden yellow, and emerald green — converge into a graphic stage, centered at the exact point the planes meet, framed from an elevated three-quarter angle so the planes visibly recede in crisp perspective, flat poster-style key light with no soft falloff, hard graphic shadows stacking cleanly at each seam where planes meet, genuinely matte non-reflective paper with visible grain and fiber texture up close, no soft gradients anywhere in the background, no props or additional objects beyond the paper stage, bold graphic-design editorial finish
